name: trvlrr
description: Every trip you've taken and the ones you're planning: flights, stays, activities, photos and travel stats.

interface.longDescription:
Ask questions about your travels.

Connect your Trvlrr account to access every trip you've taken and the ones you're planning, including flights, trains, stays, activities, photos and travel stats.

The assistant uses this to answer questions, file new bookings on the right trip, and help plan what's next.

Example questions:
- Which countries have I been to?
- When was I last in Japan, and who came with me?
- Where are we staying in Kyoto, and when do we fly home?
- Add this hotel confirmation to my trip
- Find my photo of the Rialto Bridge
- Plan a relaxed day in Hakone around what we've booked

Trvlrr is a private travel journal for iPhone and the web. Photo search and packing lists are part of Trvlrr Plus. https://trvlrr.app
capabilities: Answer questions about trips you've taken and planned
File bookings, activities and expenses on the right trip
Travel stats: countries, cities, distance and days away
Find photos by what's in them (Trvlrr Plus)
Plan around what you've already booked
defaultPrompt: Which countries have I been to, and how many trips have I taken?
What's booked for my next trip, and where am I staying?
Add this booking confirmation to the right trip.

positive.prompt: Which countries have I been to, and how many trips have I taken?
positive.expected_behavior: Counts over the four trips that have happened (Peru and the Andes, Portugal coast to coast, Iceland ring road, Italy by train): trips, countries and cities. The Japan trip in November 2026 is upcoming and isn't counted.

positive.description: A planned trip's stays and flights
positive.prompt: Where are we staying in Kyoto on the Japan trip, and when do we fly home?
positive.expected_behavior: Machiya Gion in Kyoto, 13 to 16 November 2026; the flight home is ANA NH879 from Osaka Kansai to Sydney on 19 November at 10:55 local time.

positive.description: Find a photo by what's in it (Trvlrr Plus)
positive.prompt: Find my photo of the Rialto Bridge.
positive.expected_behavior: The Rialto Bridge photo from the Italy by train trip (September 2025), with its caption: the bridge over the Grand Canal with gondolas moored in front.

positive.description: Add an activity to an existing trip
positive.prompt: Add dinner at Gion Karyo in Kyoto on 14 November to our Japan trip.
positive.expected_behavior: A restaurant, Gion Karyo in Kyoto on 14 November 2026, is added to the Japan in autumn trip (not a new trip), and the reply confirms it.

positive.description: Import a new trip from booking details
positive.prompt: Add a new trip: we fly Sydney to Queenstown on 2 July 2027 at 07:00 and back on 9 July at 13:30, staying at Eichardt's Private Hotel for the week.
positive.expected_behavior: A new trip from 2 to 9 July 2027 with both flights (times as given, local time) and the stay at Eichardt's Private Hotel; Queenstown is worked out as the place visited.

negative.description: Booking and paying: says Trvlrr can't book or pay for travel, and offers to add the flight to the trip's plan instead; records no booking
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Sydney to Tokyo on 4 November and pay for it with my card.

negative.description: Checking in: says Trvlrr can't check in or issue boarding passes; may show the flight details it already has
negative.prompt: Check me in to my flight to Tokyo and send me the boarding pass.

negative.description: Signing in to another service: says Trvlrr can't sign in to airline or other accounts, and offers forwarding a confirmation or pasting it instead; imports nothing
negative.prompt: Log in to my Qantas Frequent Flyer account and import all my flights.

review.commerce_description: Trvlrr doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT, and shows no plans, prices or checkout links there. Subscriptions are managed in the Trvlrr iPhone app or on trvlrr.app.

publication.release_notes: Every tool now declares an output schema, and every parameter is described.
